summary: SBC proposes a device‑level “School Mode” framework to manage screen‑time, preserve emergency communication, and address CIPA gaps, and urges the FCC to consider this approach and related policy points. The Safer Buildings Coalition proposes a school‑mode feature for student cell phones that automatically limits distracting apps while preserving emergency and parental communication, arguing it balances safety, mental‑health, and instructional goals. The comment argues for limiting cell‑phone use in schools, citing academic benefits, parental safety concerns, and broad public support. No E‑Rate policy claims identified in the provided text. No policy claims identified in the provided text. The provided text discusses technical design and implementation considerations for a proposed “School Mode” feature on mobile devices, focusing on troubleshooting, security, privacy, and operational challenges. It does not contain any explicit policy claims or requested actions related to FCC E‑Rate topics.
